title: AWS Trainium 與 Neuron 系統
summary: 以專用核心、編譯器及叢集共同設計解析AWS Trainium 與 Neuron 系統：六個原理與架構單元、十二項可保存的分析及驗證作業，附假想量化例、來源及衍生工程比較。
summaryEn: Explore AWS Trainium and Neuron system through specialized cores, compilers and cluster co-design: six principle/architecture units and twelve saved analysis/validation tasks, with an assumed numerical example, primary sources and related engineering comparisons.
scope: 原創張量、運算成本及失效分析。架構圖是功能教學示意，非晶片floorplan或專有電路；數字為假想，需依精度、shape、資料分佈與系統邊界重算。
scopeEn: Original tensor, compute-cost and failure analysis. Functional diagrams are not chip floorplans/proprietary circuits; assumed values need recalculation for precision, shape, data and boundaries.

stages.title: 系統邊界與基本原理
stages.description: 在AWS Trainium 與 Neuron 系統案例中比較NeuronCore算術路徑與vector與稀疏算子，各完成分析及驗證。
stages.descriptionEn: Analyze and validate neuroncore arithmetic paths and vector/sparse operators within the AWS Trainium and Neuron system case.

steps.title: 矩陣核心與精度：架構分析
steps.titleEn: Matrix cores and precision: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對NeuronCore算術路徑提出可反駁的矩陣核心與精度模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable matrix cores and precision model and evidence record for neuroncore arithmetic paths.
steps.instruction: 在「AWS Trainium 與 Neuron 系統」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識NeuronCore算術路徑。專用矩陣單元以特定精度及shape執行；低精度吞吐量不能當成FP64能力。 建立矩陣核心與精度的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是專用核心、編譯器及叢集共同設計。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。固定矩陣工作量比較計算誤差及各精度路徑。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify neuroncore arithmetic paths in the mentor diagram and primary sources for AWS Trainium and Neuron system. Matrix units use supported shapes/precisions; low-precision throughput is not FP64 capability. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of matrix cores and precision, focusing on specialized cores, compilers and cluster co-design. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare error and supported paths at fixed matrix workload. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 固定矩陣工作量比較計算誤差及各精度路徑。
steps.observationEn: Compare error and supported paths at fixed matrix workload.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：FP8、FP32、FP64 的峯值可不加標示直接比較。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Unlabeled FP8, FP32 and FP64 peaks are directly comparable.
steps.check: 提交NeuronCore算術路徑的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for neuroncore arithmetic paths.

knowledge.title: 矩陣核心與精度
knowledge.text: 專用矩陣單元以特定精度及shape執行；低精度吞吐量不能當成FP64能力。 本課架構對應：NeuronCore算術路徑
knowledge.textEn: Matrix units use supported shapes/precisions; low-precision throughput is not FP64 capability. Course architecture correspondence: NeuronCore arithmetic paths

knowledge.title: 獨立驗證與失效邊界
knowledge.text: 固定矩陣工作量比較計算誤差及各精度路徑。 應逐項保留基準與不確定度；FP8、FP32、FP64 的峯值可不加標示直接比較。 是本單元要排除的誤解。
knowledge.textEn: Compare error and supported paths at fixed matrix workload. Retain each reference and uncertainty; reject the misconception: Unlabeled FP8, FP32 and FP64 peaks are directly comparable.

knowledge.title: 原創假想量化練習
knowledge.text: 假設算術強度 I=5 FLOP/byte、頻寬 B=0.8 TB/s、計算峯值 41 TFLOP/s，理想 roofline=min(41,I×B)=4.0 TFLOP/s。皆非產品規格，未含同步、精度轉換或工作形狀損失。
knowledge.textEn: Assume I=5 FLOP/byte, B=0.8 TB/s and compute peak 41 TFLOP/s: ideal roofline min(41,I×B)=4.0 TFLOP/s. These are not product specifications; synchronization, precision conversion and shape inefficiency are omitted.

knowledge.title: 任務延伸｜遊戲交班延伸：先界定介面
knowledge.titleEn: Mission extension | Campaign transfer: define interfaces first
knowledge.text:
本課「AWS Trainium 與 Neuron 系統」的「矩陣核心與精度：架構分析」是這項延伸任務的檢核點。 畫出輸入資料、處理狀態、傳輸與輸出的邊界，在每條箭頭旁寫量、單位、正方向與資料版本。再打開「算力中心：核心不是答案」，比較哪一個介面可類比、哪一個不可類比；不可因為畫面相似就共用數值參數。

需留下的證據：提交一張介面圖與輸入版本、時間追蹤、資源計數與可重播的小型測試的欄位樣本；將假設值、來源值與本次實測值分欄。

驗證與交接：每個介面至少有一個可核對量；提出一項能讓模型失效的邊界改變，而不是只重述公式。
knowledge.textEn:
The checkpoint is “Matrix cores and precision: architecture analysis” in “AWS Trainium and Neuron system”. Draw the input, processing state, transport and output boundaries; label quantities, units, sign conventions and data revisions on each arrow. Open “Compute Center: Cores Are Not the Answer” and identify which interfaces transfer and which do not. Similar-looking scenes do not justify shared numerical parameters.

Evidence to retain: Submit an interface diagram and sample fields for input version, time traces, resource counters and a replayable small test, separating assumed, sourced and newly measured values.

Verification and handover: Each interface has a checkable quantity. Identify one boundary change that invalidates the model instead of merely repeating a formula.

quiz.question: 就NeuronCore算術路徑的「矩陣核心與精度」，哪個推論或驗證成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which inference or check is justified for matrix cores and precision in neuroncore arithmetic paths?
options: 專用矩陣單元以特定精度及shape執行；低精度吞吐量不能當成FP64能力。
FP8、FP32、FP64 的峯值可不加標示直接比較。
兩個案例的平均相同，就足以排除空間、時間及模型誤差。
optionsEn: Matrix units use supported shapes/precisions; low-precision throughput is not FP64 capability.
Unlabeled FP8, FP32 and FP64 peaks are directly comparable.
Equal case averages rule out spatial, temporal and model errors.
quiz.explanation: 專用矩陣單元以特定精度及shape執行；低精度吞吐量不能當成FP64能力。 固定矩陣工作量比較計算誤差及各精度路徑。
quiz.explanationEn: Matrix units use supported shapes/precisions; low-precision throughput is not FP64 capability. Compare error and supported paths at fixed matrix workload.

steps.title: 矩陣核心與精度：證據驗證
steps.titleEn: Matrix cores and precision: evidence validation
steps.objective: 針對NeuronCore算術路徑提出可反駁的矩陣核心與精度模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable matrix cores and precision model and evidence record for neuroncore arithmetic paths.
steps.instruction: 沿用前一步「矩陣核心與精度」模型，檢查NeuronCore算術路徑的兩個假想案例。固定矩陣工作量比較計算誤差及各精度路徑。 先訂可接受誤差，再比較預測與獨立計算；區分專用矩陣單元以特定精度及shape執行；低精度吞吐量不能當成FP64能力。與另一個可能造成相同輸出的機制。保存輸入、殘差、不確定度及採信／保留理由。缺少公開資料就標示尚未驗證，不補造產品數字。
steps.instructionEn: Use the previous matrix cores and precision model to inspect two hypothetical cases involving neuroncore arithmetic paths. Compare error and supported paths at fixed matrix workload. Set acceptable error before comparing predictions with an independent calculation. Distinguish "Matrix units use supported shapes/precisions; low-precision throughput is not FP64 capability." from an alternative cause with similar output. Save inputs, residuals, uncertainty and accept/hold reasoning. Mark absent public evidence as unverified rather than inventing product values.
steps.observation: 固定矩陣工作量比較計算誤差及各精度路徑。
steps.observationEn: Compare error and supported paths at fixed matrix workload.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：FP8、FP32、FP64 的峯值可不加標示直接比較。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Unlabeled FP8, FP32 and FP64 peaks are directly comparable.
steps.check: 提交NeuronCore算術路徑的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for neuroncore arithmetic paths.

steps.title: 向量純量與嵌入：架構分析
steps.titleEn: Vectors, scalars and embeddings: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對vector與稀疏算子提出可反駁的向量純量與嵌入模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable vectors, scalars and embeddings model and evidence record for vector/sparse operators.
steps.instruction: 在「AWS Trainium 與 Neuron 系統」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識vector與稀疏算子。矩陣算子外的向量、標量與稀疏存取可能成爲瓶頸。 建立向量純量與嵌入的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是專用核心、編譯器及叢集共同設計。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。拆分矩陣與embedding／逐元素的時間預算。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify vector/sparse operators in the mentor diagram and primary sources for AWS Trainium and Neuron system. Vector, scalar and sparse work outside matrix operations can dominate. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of vectors, scalars and embeddings, focusing on specialized cores, compilers and cluster co-design. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Separate matrix and embedding/elementwise time budgets. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 拆分矩陣與embedding／逐元素的時間預算。
steps.observationEn: Separate matrix and embedding/elementwise time budgets.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：所有神經網絡算子都在矩陣單元滿速執行。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Every neural operator runs at matrix-unit peak speed.
steps.check: 提交vector與稀疏算子的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for vector/sparse operators.
